current_host.record: os, arch, filesystem of scope root, capability probe results

linux: probe inotify availability and watch limits
detect filesystems returning DT_UNKNOWN from enumeration
macos: probe searchfs syscall availability on the scope volume
probe FSEvents CopyUUIDForDevice and per-volume stream creation
identify the scope root filesystem as apfs or other
windows: probe FSCTL_ENUM_USN_DATA privilege on the scope volume
identify ntfs volumes and reparse point behavior

fallback_obligations: capability-denied native sources fall back to the portable walker with identical coverage obligations
fallback activation is recorded in the run manifest with the capability evidence
an unqualified filesystem is reported unqualified, never generalized from apfs evidence

mandatory_native_jobs.fallback: dua-core bulk reader walker with scope fencing
portable walker with explicit unknown-type metadata fallback

skip_policy: a mandatory test reported ignored or absent from the executed log fails the integration verdict; unavailable native infrastructure is BLOCKED, never green
supported_cases: macos apfs searchfs volume candidate source with continuation and restart
macos fsevents per-volume history with drop detection
linux buffered enumeration with DT_UNKNOWN fallback and inotify watching
windows ntfs usn enumeration and journal replay with ordinary privileges
portable walker on every platform as the always-available reference
unsupported_cases: hfsplus searchfs qualification is unqualified unless separately evidenced
network or removable filesystems are excluded from native volume sources
usn journal replay without the required privilege falls back, never elevates
cloud placeholder files are not hydrated by metadata-only discovery
